title: Cross-layer rescale mesh: calibration pipeline, CI gating, and fused-kernel runtime hooks
creator: Maya Patel
description: Implement a production-ready cross-layer rescale mesh to enable activation-aware INT8 inference for transformer models, with an end-to-end calibration pipeline, CI gating for accuracy, and new fused-kernel runtime hooks for scaled INT8 matmuls. This ticket covers pipeline orchestration, serialization format for rescale metadata, calibration harness changes, CI/bench gating thresholds, runtime kernel selector and fallback semantics, telemetry events, and console rollout controls.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration pipeline can produce a serialized rescale mesh (per-layer per-input/per-output float32 scale factors) and attach it to model bundles
CI regression gate fails if top-1 generation or embedding cosine drops more than 0.25% on the validation suite compared to FP16 baseline
Runtime can select fused int8-rescale matmul kernels at model load time given rescale metadata; fallback to compatibility kernel documented
End-to-end smoke benchmarks demonstrate <=1.3x latency overhead vs existing INT8 path with improved accuracy over naive per-layer static quantization
Telemetry emits quant.profile.loaded, quant.kernel.selected, quant.fallback.reason with stable schemas
Design and API docs updated in Confluence and console rollout flag added for canary deployment
tasks: Design serialization format for rescale mesh (proto v1) and schema validation
Extend calibration harness to collect per-tensor activation moments across representative workloads
Implement rescale-merge step to compute stable scaling factors (per-head and per-gemm where applicable)
Add encoder to bundle rescale metadata into model.tar (models/redwood/rescale_v1.json)
Runtime: add kernel selector that prefers fused int8-rescale kernels if rescale metadata present
Runtime: implement fallback logic with explicit reason codes (missing-metadata, unsupported-arch, numeric-instability)
CI: add calibration+accuracy stage and gating job with auto-reporting to PRs
Validation: run regression suite (NLU generation + embeddings + long-context token continuation) and publish dashboard
Docs: update Console rollout controls, SDK examples, and internal runbook for debugging quantized models
notes: This approach aims to decouple calibration (offline) from runtime numeric kernel details by shipping a compact rescale mesh instead of model rewriting.
Prefer float32 scale factors in bundle to avoid brittle quantization-precision coupling during runtime kernel selection.
We will target AVX512 and CUDA kernels initially; other ISAs will use compatibility path until fused kernels are implemented.
Calibration should be resilient to distribution shifts; use per-batch robust percentiles (e.g., 99.9th clipped) when estimating peak activations.
Telemetry design: attach a model-level checksum to quant.profile.loaded events so we can correlate regressions with specific rescale meshes.
